svg.text: FIGURE 6 · BUILT AND RUN BY CODEX
A spec with checkpoints, two operator steps, no secret in the agent
the coding agent learns the command lines once; the operator types only the two secrets
WHAT CODEX RUNS, AND NEVER DOES
never: reads a secret, runs ADMIN,
touches objects the demo did not make,
edits a script to make a check pass
